systemSlots.use: Brand color — primary buttons, links, active states.
Deeper brand tone — footer / accent band (NOT a black dark-band; church tone stays light).
Eyebrows, small emphasis, secondary highlight (may equal primary).
Alt band / card surface (subtle warm tint).
Text ON a photo/overlay hero (light ink). Used sparingly — see church tone note.
Muted text on a photo/overlay hero.

tokens.autoPairedForegrounds: `--brand-{slot}-fg` are WCAG-AA auto-paired by contrast.ts — do not assign.
